'''''Triumph''''' was the title of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] silhouette throwing his arms into the air in a triumphant gesture.

==Behind the scenes==
''Triumph'' was one of three paintings given out to players of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during the game's [[:w:c:swg:Life Day|Life Day event]] of 2005.
